# rustinion_device_tag (Resource)

Manages one tag on one device. Tags drive device filters, tag-scoped silences and notification routes. The tag is stored trimmed and lowercased.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String)
- `tag` (String) 1-100 characters, no `/`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<device_id>/<tag>`, also the import ID.
